title: Macar Foods — olive oil distributor
body:
Macar Foods is a business distributor operating in the olive oil trade, serving retailers, grocers, specialty shops, and food-service buyers. A home-base maker of fresh-made homemade olive oil would approach this distributor as a wholesale account, supplying finished, labelled product in case quantities for onward sale to shops and markets. Its operating region is recorded as United States.

Distributors of this kind handle ordering, warehousing, and onward delivery, and they judge a new product on shelf life, packaging, labelling, consistent supply, and repeat demand. For olive oil, freshness dating, storage conditions, and clear ingredient labelling matter on every shipment, and small makers do best when they can promise steady restocking rather than a single large delivery.
